purpose: Student-controlled printable Physics practice assembled locally from QA-approved, pre-authored family-Bank instances. The browser does not author or modify physics questions.
hard_rules: Keep Student Bank and Student Practice Builder at Unit level on both the Physics student dashboard and Physics teacher dashboard.
Student selects Unit, exact I Can statements, and question count; no Family A/B/C controls are exposed to students.
Whenever an I Can is shown, display its canonical code and full exact statement together.
Questions come only from an APPROVED + QA PASS banks/unitN/student_practice_pool.json.

A production-ready Unit pool covers every exact I Can and every approved A/B/C family in the COMPLETE downstream-ready Physics Unit Bank, with four solved fresh instances per family unless explicit teacher instruction changes that count.
If the selected Unit pool is missing or not APPROVED / QA PASS, fail closed rather than authoring questions in the browser.
The browser may select and reorder approved instances only; it may not change wording, values, diagrams, tables, choices, answers, solutions, or physics.
Generated questions are grouped by exact I Can statement.
Use the approved clean worksheet style: compact heading, blank whitespace workspace, no ruled lines or bordered work boxes unless a mathematical/diagram response surface itself requires one.
Preserve Physics representations that carry evidence, including diagrams, force/vector models, tables, data, and equations.
Provide Student PDF, separate Answer Key PDF, New Version, and Print / Save PDF.
Support ?unit=N and optional ?ican=<canonical I Can ID> so dashboard and Portfolio routes can preselect a target without student identity in the URL.
MathJax uses \( ... \) and \[ ... \] delimiters only; literal currency is not interpreted as math.
Do not add a Teacher Practice Builder to this contract; that is a separate later course-level tool.
